status: adopted for Phase F specification; not complete-plan or runtime acceptance
title: Common authority for admitted work and surviving obligations
problem: Cross-domain work must have continuing custody and a consistent agenda without making the owner the routine coordinator.
decision: Adopt S1.0, derived from repaired A, with one logical admission authority, native production and protected consequence/evidence/recovery boundaries.
alternatives: S0 native tools with manual coordination
B native federation and independent issuers
epistemic_basis: Structural inference: fewer independently administered internal coordination contracts; no measured superiority.
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen if omitted duties or proportional owner coordination persist; prefer S0 if equivalent outcomes cost less, B for beneficial real administrative autonomy, C2 for useful neglected inquiry.

status: adopted for Phase F specification; not complete-plan or runtime acceptance
title: Specialized production without a department-agent roster
problem: Actual company delivery needs different methods and competent standing, not a named model per function.
decision: Allocate known predicates to deterministic code, waits/repetition to durable procedures, interpretation/generation to bounded model work, and real human/professional/physical work to accepted capable performers.
epistemic_basis: Design allocation by work/authority; persistent identity benefit remains unproved.
accepted_design_costs: Unavailable real performers remain operational blockers
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen an allocation when measured outcomes, cost or continuity favor another mode without greater unauthorized consequence.

status: adopted for Phase F specification; not complete-plan or runtime acceptance
title: One ordered consequential release boundary
problem: Duplicated business effects, conflicting permissions and restored missing promises can create undetected exposure.
decision: Adopt transactional authority per overlapping scope with exact operation prerequisites, business conflict holds, independently durable envelopes/release records and explicit cancellation/first-send semantics.
alternatives: Independent online checks without common cutoff
epistemic_basis: Conceptually reviewed contract within surviving roots; implementation proof required.
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen on a lost released operation, conflicting hold, unsafe status lookup, late invocation outside contract, or unaffordable/unavailable required roots.

status: adopted for Phase F specification; not complete-plan or runtime acceptance
title: Native meaning with conservative context validity
problem: A copied status or uncited sensitive input can silently become accepted knowledge or outward disclosure.
decision: Keep native domain records and minimal cross-boundary mappings; capture full input lineage; atomically validate usable derivatives and serialize restrictions with consequential release.
epistemic_basis: Selective integration is a design choice; utility under conservative lineage remains empirical.
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen if a restricted derivative becomes usable or permitted work is persistently blocked without acceptable value; evaluate targeted retrieval alternatives against a real failure.

status: adopted for Phase F specification; not complete-plan or runtime acceptance
title: Protect interpretation as well as evidence capture
problem: Unchanged logs or judges can mislead when parsers, denominators, source selection or administrative dependencies change.
decision: Version and protect the transitive evidence base; state each claim's independence target and separate reported rationale from established cause.
epistemic_basis: Independent conceptual review closes specified attacks, not all false evidence or shared-model error.
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen on false acceptance from a shared dependency, concealed exclusion or causal explanation stronger than its evidence.

status: adopted for Phase F specification; not complete-plan or runtime acceptance
title: Fixed contestable owner participation and meaningful external redress
problem: The owner can become confidently uninformed while affected people cannot reach a remedy.
decision: Use transparent adverse sampling and domain-specific competence response; maintain accessible grievance custody, reasons, deadlines, competent escalation and surviving remedy resources.
alternatives: Internal ticket closure as remedy completion
C2 general inquiry jurisdiction by default
epistemic_basis: Mechanisms required by the founder; longitudinal benefit and affordable institutional capacity unproved.
accepted_design_costs: Role conflicts cannot be removed by renaming
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen if unfamiliar material misunderstanding escapes, user disagreement is treated as incapacity, complaints strand, or required burden defeats viable operation.

status: adopted for Phase F specification; not complete-plan or runtime acceptance
title: Separate money, provider capacity, compute and attention
problem: Subscription access can be mistaken for unlimited capacity or silently replaced with metered usage.
decision: Preserve separate resource accounts and versioned execution adapters; admit only actual identity/auth/billing paths and explicit additional-spend policy.
alternatives: Shared customer use of personal subscription credentials
epistemic_basis: Founder constraint plus dated provider evidence; remaining allowance and future throughput unknown.
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen on changed provider terms, observed billing-path ambiguity, capability drift or sustained inability to perform within authorized capacity.

status: adopted for Phase F specification; not complete-plan or runtime acceptance
title: Controlled improvement with a protected acceptance boundary
problem: An improver can make its own results look better or expand authority while optimizing output.
decision: Require versioned evidence-backed change proposals, independent evaluation, controlled rollout and rollback; protected intent, authority, identity, evidence and evaluator dependencies require separate authorized changes.
alternatives: Mutable judge inputs outside change control
epistemic_basis: Design contract motivated by observed benchmark failure modes; company improvement benefit remains a hypothesis.
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen if cumulative accepted changes drift protected meaning, compromise evaluation or cannot be rolled back with dependent state.

status: adopted for Phase F specification; not complete-plan or runtime acceptance
title: Full capability lifecycle with actual fulfillment
problem: A catalog, plan or truthful blocked packet can be mistaken for completed company work.
decision: Require usable intake, substantive execution or accepted delegation, evidence-backed acceptance, failure, replacement and closure for every capability requirement.
alternatives: Coding vertical slice presented as complete system
epistemic_basis: Founder scope constraint; specific ventures and real operating dependencies remain unset.
accepted_design_costs: Real external mandates/capacity required before promises
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen any completion claim that lacks performance or legitimate disposition, or omits a planned capability or recovery path.

status: adopted for Phase F specification; not complete-plan or runtime acceptance
title: Selective repository reuse and reversible migration
problem: Historical harness descriptions and passing checks can be mistaken for the new system's architecture or safety proof.
decision: Reuse only mechanisms mapped and tested against selected contracts; import uncertainty, fence scope transfer and preserve old evidence and buildable states.
epistemic_basis: Direct scoped repository observations plus migration design; two existing Mission Control failures unresolved.
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen on incompatible meanings, hidden native writes, regression, lost obligations/restrictions or insufficient recovery evidence.
